content.title: Calculators header link navigates to Open Account
content.test_md_blob:
# Calculators header link navigates to Open Account

> Prove that the bank header is present on the Calculators page and that its Open Account link navigates to `/bank-clone-app/open-account`.

## Step 1

Open {{calculators_page_url}} in the browser and wait until the Calculators page is fully loaded with the bank header visible at the top of the page.

## Step 2

In the bank header on the Calculators page, follow the Open Account link and allow the site to finish navigating to the destination page.

## Step 3

On the loaded Open Account page, confirm that the bank header is still visible at the top of the page.

## Step 4 — assert @verifies ac-15, ac-16, ac-17

Confirm absolute check: /bank-clone-app/open-account (equals) — the stated promise: From the Calculators page, the header link to Open Account resolves to `/bank-clone-app/open-account`.
content.objectives_blob:
objectives:
  - objective: Open {{calculators_page_url}} in the browser and wait until the Calculators page is fully loaded with the bank header visible at the top of the page.
    step: 1
  - objective: In the bank header on the Calculators page, follow the Open Account link and allow the site to finish navigating to the destination page.
    step: 2
  - objective: On the loaded Open Account page, confirm that the bank header is still visible at the top of the page.
    step: 3
  - check:
      expected_mode: authored
      kind: absolute
      operand: /bank-clone-app/open-account
      operator: equals
      review_required: false
      verified_against: ac-15
    objective: 'Confirm absolute check: /bank-clone-app/open-account (equals) — the stated promise: From the Calculators page, the header link to Open Account resolves to `/bank-clone-app/open-account`.'
    step: 4
scenario: Calculators page header opens Open Account
title: Calculators header link navigates to Open Account

content.test_md_blob:
# Open Account page shows the persistent bank header

> Prove that the persistent bank header appears on the Open Account page.

## Step 1

Open {{open_account_page_url}} in the browser and wait until the Open Account page is fully loaded.

## Step 2

On the Open Account page, inspect the top site header area and confirm that the bank header is visible.

## Step 3 — assert @verifies ac-17

Confirm presence check: bank header (exists) — the stated promise: The bank header is present on the Open Account page.
content.objectives_blob:
objectives:
  - objective: Open {{open_account_page_url}} in the browser and wait until the Open Account page is fully loaded.
    step: 1
  - objective: On the Open Account page, inspect the top site header area and confirm that the bank header is visible.
    step: 2
  - check:
      expected_mode: authored
      kind: presence
      operand: bank header
      operator: exists
      review_required: false
      verified_against: ac-17
    objective: 'Confirm presence check: bank header (exists) — the stated promise: The bank header is present on the Open Account page.'
    step: 3
scenario: Header is present on the Open Account page
title: Open Account page shows the persistent bank header

judgements.rationale: [value_score] Highest value test pair because it covers the only explicit route-change behavior in the source and also observes header persistence across both named pages.
[value_score] Lower value than sc-7 because it checks static presence on one page only, but it remains necessary to preserve dedicated Open Account coverage.

[self_critique] Oracle-proves axis: the route-equality check directly proves the navigation promise in ac-15, and the step objectives explicitly observe the header on both source and destination pages to support ac-16 and ac-17 without over-broad URL assumptions.

[self_critique] Technique-fit axis: a simple page-presence scenario did not need boundary, negative, or combinatorial techniques because the source states only a static presence promise on a named page.

[self_critique] Negative-case axis: no negative test was minted because the evidence never states error handling, disabled links, missing-header behavior, or reverse-navigation behavior; adding such a test would invent requirements.
[self_critique] Assert-breadth axis: the tests stayed limited to the two named pages and the one stated destination path, avoiding broader claims about all header links or all site areas.
